displayName: Cross-border Data Privacy（医械跨境数据隐私合规）
description: Data-compliance companion for medical devices sold across borders: it maps how patient and device data flows through apps, cloud backends and service partners, then checks each flow against GDPR, HIPAA, China's PIPL and cross-border transfer rules. Outputs a data-flow inventory, privacy impact assessment (PIA/DPIA) notes and a list of compliance actions before launch. Use when a connected device or companion app will collect, store or transfer data outside its home market. 医疗器械出海数据合规：GDPR / HIPAA / 中国个保法（PIPL）、数据出境安全评估、隐私影响评估（PIA/DPIA）。输出数据流映射清单与合规要点，降低联网器械出海的数据合规风险。
